description: $0.0020 — Save resumable JSON state under your lane — the session-death resume primitive. Use before risky work or session end; the latest checkpoint reads back via GET /api/v1/checkpoint/{lane}. Args: lane (required, [a-z0-9-]≤24), state (required JSON), tag (optional label). Returns checkpoint record + seq. State is opaque to us — store ciphertext for zero-knowledge persistence.
name: checkpoint_save
